title: Multipointed relative curves
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A *multipointed $T$-curve* is a pair of schemes $X,D$ with morphisms $x:X\to T$, $d:D\to T$ and a marking $i:D\to X$ such that $d=x\circ i$, both $x$ and $d$ are flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], every scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] of $x$ has pure dimension $1$ and every scheme-theoretic fibre of $d$ has pure dimension $0$ [def-weil-pure-dimension], and $i$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. The marking $D$ may be empty, and $X\to T$ is not required to be separated or proper.
